Are you planning on doing this for a bunch more operations? Really would prefer a solution in bmcweb then.. If it is a few one offs, I am with this.

Can you give more info about what is the solution that can be done in the bmcweb?
Currently, bmcweb already gives error when we perform this operation with read-only user.
It is additional check in the GUI.
Interesting, Different from the implementation in this commit. But does this require any change in the bmcweb? I don't think so. Only the UI change right.

I believe that this should not require bmcweb changes.

`useSessionPrivileges()` would:
1. grab `Roles` from the `AccountService` collection
2. Go through each Role in the `Members` array
3. Check if this role matches any of the current Session's Roles (Session should be saved in place of setSessionPrivilege() used today.. )
4. Add all AssignedPrivileges from this role

This lookup should only be done once, as useSessionPrivileges() should be reactive
Done
Rebase since https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/webui-vue/+/82965/4/src/store/modules/GlobalStore.js already added this?
Rebase done
A Redfish-first approach would be to grab the list from /redfish/v1/AccountService/Roles instead, a natural place to put the call is the UserManagementStore.
Done

I disagree with this assessment.  The UI (any Redfish client) can in no way provide this type of access control for the backend.
This change is purely for the UX so that you can customize the UI layout and controls appropriate to the privileges of the session.
It is helpful to let the user know that they lack permissions for specific actions based on their current session.
Right, This is only User experience improvement.
Done
These are RoleId, please rename.
Acknowledged
Rename this the Authentication store as well, it is really the *first* in the the list of Roles for the session.  it should instead be `sessionRoles` and should be the array.
Acknowledged
Also, add this role check here always hides the bmc cards in the template!  A read-only user should still be able to see the card.
Acknowledged

with the above suggestion this becomes something like:

```
this.sessionRoles.includes("ReadOnly")
```

Again, as mentioned elsewhere, we should really be checking for a Redfish.Privilege instead of a Redfish.Role.
Acknowledged
The useI18n import from vue-i18n is added but never used anywhere in the component ?
Done
Missing null/undefined check.
Done
The else keyword is unnecessary after a return statement.
Done

Working as expected, Buttons are greyed out for Read-only user. But would like to see an alert message similar to "The attempted action is not accessible from the logged in account. Contact your system administrator to check your privilege role."

Else the user wouldn't know why it is greyed out. For a better user experience.

Thank you for the feedback! I've added an info banner at the top of the page that displays: "The attempted action is not accessible from the logged in account. Contact your system administrator to check your privilege role."

This provides immediate visibility about privilege limitations when the page loads.

Would you also like tooltips on individual disabled buttons, or is the page-level banner sufficient or this Info banner is fine?
@a.nikhil@ibm.com

I would prefer a better alert message since no operation is performed yet. Just Giving an info..

A suggestion:
"Firmware operations are not permitted for the currently logged-in account. Contact your system administrator to check your privilege"
+1 Nikhil
Done
